newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyocera to sell digital mobile phones abroad.
newsitem.headline: Kyocera to sell digital mobile phones abroad.

text.p: Kyocera Corp said on Thursday it plans to sell digital mobile phones overseas starting as early as the spring of 1998.
The company has begun developing the mobile phones under standards adopted in the United States and Europe, a company spokesman said.

In September, the company was licensed by Qualcomm Inc of the United States, which holds patent on the U.S. standard, Code Division Multiple Access, to manufacture and sell mobile phones under the standard, the spokesman said.
Kyocera, a ceramics maker, started in the mobile phone business in 1991.

The company's sales of mobile phones in Japan in the 1996/97 business year are expected to nearly double from the the previous year's 55 billion yen to more than 100 billion yen accounting for about one-fifth of the total, the spokesman said.
